en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, raising it,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Sanctuary of the river is its bank and what is adjacent to it’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father in a marfu’ manner the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
the restricted area around a canal is up to its edge and that which adjoins it.”
